description: This file defines the DictionaryDatabase class, which manages an FTS (Full-Text Search) enabled SQLite database for a dictionary application. It handles creating the database, loading initial data from a resource, and providing methods for querying words and definitions.

classes.name: DictionaryDatabase
classes.description: Main class responsible for database management, including creation, querying, and data loading.

methods.name: buildColumnMap
methods.description: Creates a mapping of column names for query projection, including aliases for ID and suggestion data.

methods.name: getWord
methods.description: Retrieves a cursor pointing to a specific word entry by row ID.

methods.name: getWordMatches
methods.description: Performs a search for words matching a query string using FTS.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a database query with specified selection and columns.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Inserts a new word and its definition into the database.
